I was contacted by the seller of this product for a favorable rating and they asked if I had an issue to reply back to their email.  I did because I have an issue.  This particular filter does not filter out chlorine properly.  My kids first noticed it when my youngest son asked me if I had changed out the filter.  Keep in mind that the previous filter (from another company) had been in service for over a year and apparently was still filtering properly.  This new filter, however, was not as my son could immediately tell that something wasn't right about the water.  I'm not as finicky as my kids are when it comes to the taste of the water, but our water comes from the city's system so you know it's processed to hell and back, especially with heavy doses of chlorine.  This filter doesn't seem to adequately remove it.  As I stated, I let my concerns be known to the company via a reply to their email, but after a few days I haven't heard anything - so I figured I'd give a rating based on my experience.  I will now have to purchase a different filter from a different company as my family is about to boycott the water in the refrigerator and start buying bottled water.  Yikes!

Unfortunately, 3 months is too short of a life for a filter that is supposed to last up to 6 months, so I am going back to purchasing this locally from now on.

If you're like me, you like to swap out water filters in your fridge. The original GE filters are crazy expensive, so either I have to not swap them out often enough, or I have to spend a ton of money. Neither sounds like a good option. So I was happy to find this Waterdrop filter that works with my GE fridge. It arrived in a box, and in that box the filter was wrapped in a bubble wrap container with instructions. I didn't need to use the instructions but I glanced over them and they made perfect sense. The filter fit perfectly into my fridge, and I ran about three gallons of water through it. The water quickly turned crystal clear, and the taste is what I expect out of a fresh filter.

So far so good at a fraction of the price!
